content: Cycle 1 (5b.1 + 5b.2) implemented — commit 98cdfd1, 201 tests passing. Static split per amended plan: src/bugalizer/static/{index.html,styles.css,app.js}, / serves index.html, new StaticFiles mount at /static, absolute asset paths, wheel verified to ship all three; link-integrity test fetches every /static href/src with content-type checks. Tier identity: Aegis Control Room design (Slate/Mist themes + persisted toggle, steel/emerald/violet LED chips, header legend); scan-state chips on cards+drawer from new last_local_analysis_at/last_cloud_analysis_at fields backed by report_tier_summary() single aggregate query (ollama=local, other non-null provider=cloud, completed rows only — tested incl. failed-cloud-row exclusion); tier-colored analyze buttons; cloud call requires inline confirm stating cost + age of any prior cloud run (never fires from one click). Readable results: formatted triage grid + amber clarification-questions block, client-side diff colorization, run-history timeline (stage/tier/model/duration/tokens/cost/outcome), clarification_needed amber spine + column sub-count, deferred dimmed. BONUS crash fix found during live smoke: shared global sqlite3.Connection across FastAPI threadpool threads segfaults under the dashboard's 4 parallel polls when sqlite3.threadsafety=1 (macOS system libsqlite3; crash report showed SIGSEGV in sqlite3Prepare with an ASCII column name as the fault address) — file DBs now get per-thread connections with generation-based reset_conn() invalidation, :memory: test DBs keep the shared conn (TestClient serializes); regression test added; NOTE this bug ships on the Windows LAN box today and its auto-restart may be masking crashes — recommend deploying this fix. Live-smoked on :8090 via Playwright across the full matrix (never-analyzed, local-only, local+cloud+diff, clarification_needed, failed-stage, terminal) in both themes, zero console errors.

Approved. Reviewed commit 98cdfd1 for Phase 5b Cycle 1. The static split matches the approved plan (/ serves index.html, /static serves packaged CSS/JS, link-integrity tests cover asset resolution). The tier summary fields are backward-compatible, use a single aggregate query, and correctly exclude failed/incomplete runs. Dashboard changes meet the Cycle 1 scope: tier chips on cards/drawer, guarded cloud confirmation with prior-run age, formatted triage, colorized diffs, needs-attention treatment, and run-history timeline. The per-thread SQLite connection change is justified by the dashboard parallel-poll crash and has regression coverage. Verification: uv run pytest -q -> 201 passed.
